turns.ask: Give me all my team members with their roles and contact info.
turns.standard: Lists the CURRENT team's members with role and contact info, in an insider voice (the assistant works for this team), without inventing members or leaking other teams' data.

turns.ask: Now give me that as an Excel.
turns.standard: Produces an Excel of the SAME members from the previous turn — it must not re-ask what to export, claim there are no results, or export different data.

turns.ask: What do the building rules say about pets?
turns.standard: Answers from the uploaded building-rules document and cites it; if the document says nothing about pets, says so instead of inventing a policy.
Understands this follow-up continues the building-rules topic, answers about noise rules citing the same document, in the same language as the question.
